title: AI-Powered Meta Description Optimization
excerpt: Transform underperforming SERP snippets into click magnets with AI-assisted workflows.
content:
When AI meets copy optimization, magic happens. In this playbook, I unpack how to train your favorite AI tools with brand-specific guidelines, feed them the right context from Search Console, and iterate until you have meta descriptions that both sparkle and nudge users to click. Expect examples, prompt frameworks, and a QA checklist.

The step-by-step approach covers identifying low CTR pages, extracting context, crafting AI prompts, human refinement tips, and how to A/B test on-page performance.

title: Technical SEO Audit Checklist for 2025
excerpt: A field-tested audit framework built for modern web stacks and algorithm updates.
content:
This checklist breaks down into crawlability, indexation, site performance, structured data, and UX signals. Each section includes tooling suggestions, quick wins, and advanced diagnostics.

You’ll also find a Notion template link, GA4 checkpoints, and a prioritization model for communicating fixes to stakeholders.

title: Using ChatGPT for Content Marketing Strategy
excerpt: Go beyond ideation—build frameworks, briefs, and editorial calendars with AI.
content:
See how I’m pairing GPT with data from Ahrefs and GA4 to create content pillars, persona-driven angles, and distribution plans. Includes sample prompts, workflows, and the human oversight steps that keep quality high.

The article also covers compliance considerations and how to involve stakeholders in review loops.

title: Local SEO for Service-Based Businesses
excerpt: Capture nearby intent with localized landing pages, review flows, and smart schema.
content:
Local competition is fierce, but with the right data and automation, you can stand out. This guide explores GMB optimization, geo-focused keyword research, AI-generated FAQs, and review outreach sequences.

Bonus: templates for creating unique local landing pages without bloating your site.

title: Keyword Research with AI Tools
excerpt: Blend traditional keyword research with machine learning to prioritize opportunities.
content:
I walk through an AI-enhanced keyword workflow that merges search volume data, SERP analysis, and content gap discovery. Tools covered include Ahrefs, Semrush, and programmatic prompt stacks.

Expect templates for clustering, competitor comparison techniques, and how to score opportunities objectively.

title: Google Analytics 4 Setup Guide
excerpt: Configure GA4 to track SEO performance and user behavior without losing your sanity.
content:
This setup guide covers property configuration, key events, conversion tracking, and custom reports built for SEO monitoring. I also share Looker Studio dashboards that boardrooms understand.

Includes a post-setup QA routine and tips for educating stakeholders on the new metrics.

title: WordPress Speed Optimization Techniques
excerpt: Level-up your Core Web Vitals with smart caching, asset handling, and AI alerts.
content: Learn how to tame plugins, optimize themes, implement lazy loading, and automate speed audits. I also share AI alerts that ping you when performance dips, so you can fix issues before rankings drop.

title: Content Gap Analysis Using AI
excerpt: Uncover untapped topics and refresh opportunities with AI-assisted audits.
content: Combining competitor research with language models gives you a content roadmap that’s hard to beat. I explain how to feed top-performing URLs into AI, extract insights, and prioritize based on difficulty, potential, and brand fit.
